description: Wave 2 HUMAN / Welded / fallen-bad-cyborg powers/antagonists (10). They KEEP human faces/flesh (no human-realism negative), but 'pristine/clean' is negated so the bad-cyborgs read FALLEN/corroded, never Gen-2-clean.

defaults.negative: pristine, clean, sleek, glossy, chrome, shiny, new, polished, neon, bright even daylight, deformed, mutated, extra limbs, extra arms, extra fingers, fused fingers, bad anatomy, malformed face, two heads, skull, skeleton, skeletal, anime, manga, cel shading, chibi, flat vector illustration, clean line art, 3d render, cgi, glossy photoreal photograph, oversaturated, cartoon, text, watermark, signature, label

subjects.prompt: a gaunt aging human man, an ash-stained reinforced-polymer suit with a frayed collar, thin silvered hair, milky eyes from filtered light, a cracked etched colony medallion at his chest, severe and grief-worn, a tower council leader, full-figure character concept, grounded painterly, cold filtered light

a human tower enforcer, heavy rust-spotted plated exo-armor patched with plates, a visor cracked at the left edge, a faded security insignia on a scarred forearm, a battered rifle with a copper-wire silencer, dutiful but haunted, in a grimy under-city tunnel, full-figure character concept, grounded painterly, dim sodium light

a wiry human body-broker, a threadbare coat patched with blood-stained fabric, a leather apron stained with oil and ash, scarred hands with broken nails, a thin copper necklace of small bone fragments, a hollow-eyed stare, at a grim under-city reclamation stall, full-figure character concept, grounded painterly, dim sodium light

a heavy fallen cyborg enforcer, oxidized pauldrons and chest-plating bolted directly into weathered human flesh, one leg a grinding piston-strut, a face of scar tissue and cold corroded steel, one eye a flickering targeting sensor, standing rigid at a ruined checkpoint, full-figure character concept, grounded painterly, dim sodium light
